operational.name: Yoga practice
operational.description: A log of your yoga sessions, a weekly target and streak, and your resting heart rate and HRV beside them, with sessions from Apple Health.

demo.name: Yoga practice
demo.description: Six weeks of synthetic yoga practice with a weekly target, streak and recovery trend.

presentation.outcome: Practice yoga every week: three sessions or two hours.
connectors: Apple Health · your own import: yoga, mindfulness and pilates workouts, resting heart rate and HRV, read only
steps: Add the date, minutes, style, intensity, focus areas and a note, or edit and delete one later.
Yoga, mind and body, pilates and flexibility workouts and mindful sessions become sessions once each; tag their style afterwards.
See minutes this week against your target, how many weeks in a row you met it and how your practice splits by style.
Weekly practice minutes beside your average resting heart rate and heart rate variability.
presentation.access: A personal app: only you, its owner, see and change your sessions. It reads your Apple Health import through your own grant and never writes to it. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
